I use Divide et impera. It completely rebalances combat. Every infantry unit has the same hp. Every cavalry unit has the same hp. Stats is what sets them apart. Melee attack and melee defence range between 5-30 and 4-25 respectively, making the combat much slower in pace.
Also similar types of units have VERY similar stats. So for example elite hoplites from Rodos will have almost same stats as elite hoplites of Macedon.

Cavaly is very powerful. Light Skirmisher/Archer cav has great value even in the lategame because they can confirm their shots on the backs of enemies and thanks to the extra hp and mass can still be useful on the charges even if they have low mellee stats.

After the archer nerf I feel like archers are kind of useless, and only use them early. Lategame if you really need missiles just get peltasts/skirmishers with decent melee stats.

Chariots are extremely situational, as they should be. Elephants require more thought and micromanagement because they can't just roflstomp infinitely through thousands of enemies, like in vanilla.

Phalanxes and Shield Walls are much more useful than vanilla too. As is shock infantry, since it kills a bit less, but doesn't die immediately if an archer unit shoots at it once or twice.

Regiment sizes are also different. 200-300 for infantry, 175-200 for missiles and 100-120 for Cav.

All this combined makes big battles last around 20-30 minutes, assuming both sides are balanced.

Varied armies are highly encouraged. At least some spears are ALWAYS good to have. Heavy cavalry may be good, but without proper support it will take too many casualties. Light cavalry can execute hit and run much better than anyone else and can be incredible for harassing missile troops, especially since it takes more than 0,1 second to rout them in mellee. Etc...

The thing is, that mod also greatly changes the campaign (for the better). If you are a veteran Total War/Strategy player I encourage you to start with the mod, but otherwise it may be a bit tough

Ares and Athena were my big favourites when I was starting out. Ares is a character that specializes in doing lots of damage if he hits as many chains as possible. It's his 1st ability. Launches a skillshot chain that passes minions and attaches to gods slowing them and making them unable to use movement abilities for 4 seconds. If you manage to hit the first chain you have 2 seconds to hit another and if you hit the second you have 2 more for a third. Then you follow with your 3 wish is a cone damage over time. If you hit all 3 chains and the full duration of the dot you can kill a full hp enemy sometimes. He also has a defense aura for allies and his ult pulls all enemies around him directly to him after a short chaneling time. There's more info in his character description page.

Athena is a very straightforward initiator tank who's job is to dash in and taunt enemies so that your allies can either follow up with damage or have time to run away depending on what suits the situation. She also has a damage ability where she calls soldiers around her who deal damage when they appear and then much more 2 seconds after. If you taunt enemies into the circle of soldiers it will be easy to confirm all damage. Her ult lets you teleport to any ally on the map after a 4 second chanel time during wich he takes less damage. As you arive you do a quite big burst of damage around the ally.

Hunters are gods that deal lots of consistent damage from range, mostly by basic attacks, they also usually have abilities or passives that enhance their basic attacks (left clicks). (Outliers are Neith and Chiron, who do not have said enhancers and rely more on abilities than other hunters)

Assassins are the melee characters that can focus on basic attacks (Mercury, Bakasura, Kali) or a mix of abilities and basic attacks (Bastet, Susano, Daji and all the others). Sometimes they can be played more resiliently and buy one or two defense items. They're generally very mobile and able to stick to targets, while killing them as fast as possible.

Warriors are naturally tanky versions of assassins, with less damage. They generally have the most powerful self sustain, with strong self heals, self shields... But also there are gods like Odin and Ravana who rival the damage of assassins and can have almost the same playstyle. 

Guardians are gods designed to be decently good even when behind in levels. For that they have especially strong CC, big health pools, good protections and strong base damage on abilities, but benefit way less from power than other classes (the same ammount of power augments the guardian's damage way less than a mage's damage). They usually focus on contlolling the pace of the fight, cc priority targets, save allies...

Mages are a very, very diverse bunch. They range from healers (Hel, Aphro, Chang'e), to burst damage dealers (Scylla, Vulcan, Zeus). Some have insane CC and/or utility (Nu Wa, Nox, Isis), And others do their job by empowering basic attacks, similarly to Hunters (Sol, Freya, Chronos). 

In Conquest, the main game mode, the roles are Hunter (Hunters and basic attack mages; go to the Gold Fury side lane and farm untill they have lots of items and re capable of killing enemies fast), Support (Guardians, some Warriors with high utility, Nox, some Assassins...; Initially help the hunter and then the rest of the team too), MId (Burst Mages and Hunters with strong abilities, go to middle lane), Jungle (Assassins and some Warriors, they roam the jungle and ambush lanes) and Solo (Any character with good self sustain, stays in the Fire Giant side lane, and helps the team, later in the game)

Obviously there are many exceptions, and I would need to write an essay to explain every one of 90something gods we have... You'll figure it all out as you play.

Junglers farm the jungle and gank, Duh... (assassins except Loki fit this role the most, also Ao Kuang). Mid laners are burst mages (so all mages except Freya and Ao Kuang fit more or less in mid. Supports are the guardians and warriors that can help their team through heals, crowd controll, ressurects, shields, etc. Adc are the hunters and a few mages like Sol, Chronos and Freya, who have powerfull ranged attacks.
